patch.value: Bump pm-cli dependency and package version from 2026.7.27 to 2026.7.28 across package.json, manifest.json, and src/index.ts. Also fix audit:prod script to use the hardened form required by project-scoped installs.

Bumped @unbrained/pm-cli from ^2026.7.27 to ^2026.7.28 in devDependencies and from >=2026.7.27 to >=2026.7.28 in peerDependencies; bumped package version to 2026.7.28 in package.json, manifest.json, and the EXTENSION_VERSION constant plus the hardcoded version literal in the pm-graph status help schema in src/index.ts; fixed audit:prod script from plain npm audit --omit=dev to the hardened env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm audit --omit=dev --ignore-scripts form required by project-scoped installs (matching the fleet standard); regenerated CHANGELOG via changelog:full; npm install resolved pm-cli 2026.7.28; release:check passes (typecheck, build, 97 tests, audit, pack dry-run, changelog check).
